capabilities: Encrypt folders and their files with a password
Generate a recovery key at setup
extras: Freemium: free protects one folder; Pro ($5 lifetime) adds unlimited folders, whole-vault protection, auto-lock, lock on quit, hidden file names and per-folder passwords. Pro license checks contact Polar; no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian stores notes and attachments as plain files on disk, so private material is readable without a password.
summary: Folder encryption plugin that locks notes and attachments on disk with a password and recovery key.
